assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson has a highly distinctive voice. She joins classical scholarship, lyric, verse-novel, translation, essay and visual or material form, as in Autobiography of Red and Nox. Her formal inventiveness and intellectual depth are unusually concentrated, and the work renews the relation between ancient and modern literature. Her achievement is well supported across poetry, essay and drama.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on formal renewal of lyric and narrative through classical and hybrid forms. The single credited name fits a body of work that is plainly individual. Her translations and classical adaptations could blur the boundary of what is credited as original creation.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre spans several decades and has remained inventive without repeating itself. Its durability looks strong, though much of its reputation rests on a few landmark books.
uncertainties: My assessment relies on public knowledge, not verified reading of the whole corpus.
Her performance and visual-object works are hard to judge from translation or print reproductions.
It is unclear whether the hybrid mode will be treated as a core literary achievement within Nobel's will.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu offers visionary, densely patterned prose that makes memory, the body and cosmology into a large metaphysical project. Works such as Blinding and Solenoid show strong imaginative ambition and sustained stylistic control. His poetry also contributes to the case. His distinctiveness of voice and scale is high.
assessment.attribution: The proposed citation would cover Romanian-language fiction and poetry that renews the visionary and encyclopedic novel. The credit is unambiguous and the single name is appropriate.
assessment.maturity: His oeuvre is long and internally coherent, and the major works are recent enough to show late-career strength. Consolidation of his reputation across languages is still ongoing.
uncertainties: Romanian prose and poetry depend heavily on translation, so judgments of linguistic achievement are uncertain.
I cannot independently verify how consistently the quality holds across all of his books.
Some of the later work may be repetitive in its imagery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Tawada writes in both Japanese and German and turns linguistic estrangement into a literary method. Narrative, poetry, essay and drama all use it, as in The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear. The voice is distinctive, the formal play is precise, and the work engages questions of language, migration and ecology with intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on writing between languages as a formal and imaginative principle. The credit is clear for the single named writer. Because she works in two languages, no single language can fully represent her oeuvre.
assessment.maturity: She has decades of production across several genres and continuing development. Her reception is broad and well established.
uncertainties: Her work is divided between Japanese and German, and I cannot judge the quality of both equally.
Translation may flatten or add to the wordplay that matters most to her work.
The share of her work that is at the highest level is not verifiable by me.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis remade modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a long, critical dialogue with inherited forms. Works such as Songs of Mihyar the Damascene mark a major formal intervention. His essays and criticism extend the significance of his work within Arabic literary history. He has a strong claim on formal and linguistic achievement.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on renewal of Arabic poetry and of the critical vocabulary around it. The credit is individual and clear. His essays and political commentary should be kept distinct from the poetic achievement being weighed.
assessment.maturity: He has a very long, established oeuvre with considerable influence. The core work is mostly from earlier decades, so the case rests on historical significance more than recent output.
uncertainties: The achievement is largely in Arabic prosody and diction, which is hard to assess in translation.
Some of his public political positions are controversial. They are not themselves evidence of literary merit.
Late-career quality is less clear to me than the mid-career peak.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Can Xue writes dreamlike, uncompromising narrative worlds that disrupt ordinary psychology, space and causality. Her voice is unmistakable and her commitment to experimental form has been sustained. Her imaginative autonomy is a strong point, with works such as Frontier and Love in the New Millennium representing it.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on radical formal experiment in Chinese fiction. The credit is clear and individual.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is long and consistent in its aims. The consistency is a strength, but it raises a question about variety and development.
uncertainties: Translation of her syntax and imagery may affect how the work is judged.
I have limited ability to verify her short stories compared with the novels.
Some readers may find the work repetitive in mode, and I cannot adjudicate that from the supplied evidence.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Zurita builds large poetic sequences, such as Purgatory and Anteparadise, that turn suffering and historical trauma into collective memorial form. His landscape-scale and public-text interventions extend what poetry can do. The linguistic and imaginative ambition is high and the voice is recognizable.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on poetry as memorial and collective witness in Spanish. The single credit is clear. The non-textual works are part of the poetic project but harder to weigh as literature.
assessment.maturity: His oeuvre is long and coherent. The central works are tied to the Chilean dictatorship and its aftermath, which gives the project weight but may narrow its range.
uncertainties: The poetry depends heavily on Spanish-language rhythm and register, which translation may not carry.
The role of political and historical symbolism must be separated from literary quality.
The literary status of the landscape works is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Murnane has a radically inward fiction with a rigorous and highly distinctive voice. It builds systems of landscape, memory and mental images, as in The Plains and Border Districts. The formal discipline and imaginative singularity are considerable.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on a singular literary project of memory and imagery in English prose. The single credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is sustained across several decades and is consistent in method. It is narrow in range, which may limit its significance across the full body of work.
uncertainties: The narrow thematic range may limit how broadly the achievement is judged.
I cannot verify the full extent of his later work.
His smaller international readership is not a measure of merit, but it adds uncertainty about the consensus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Robinson writes meditative prose with moral interiority that brings theology, family and American history into dialogue. Housekeeping and Gilead show a clear and sustained voice and real intellectual depth. Her essays add a further dimension. The oeuvre is small in volume, but the quality of the main novels is high.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on contemplative, morally serious fiction and essay in English. The credit is clear and individual.
assessment.maturity: Her output is relatively limited in volume, which affects the assessment of sustained range. The major novels have been durable in reception.
uncertainties: The number of major works is small, which weighs on the question of breadth.
Her religious and civic essays are a separate matter from the fiction.
I rely on public knowledge, not verified reading of the whole corpus.
